name: voithos-ai
description: Search across your past meetings and find upcoming ones with Voithos AI.

interface.longDescription: Voithos AI answers questions about your meetings: what was discussed, decisions and action items, who you met with and how often, and which meetings are scheduled next.
defaultPrompt: What did we agree on in my last meeting?
When did I last meet with Anna and what did we discuss?
What meetings do I have tomorrow?
